title: Test Edit
description: Start here to learn about our community expectations.
content:
ACCOUNT RULES
1. No Alt Abuse - Use of alts to take advantage of server rewards.
2. No Inappropriate Skin/Username - Keep it family friendly.
3. No Login Attempt - Trying to login other's username account on their own IP will be counted as another alt under your IP. And we are not responsible for that if you reach 3 accounts per IP.

SOCIAL RULES
1. No Toxicity - Harassment, profanity, personal attacks, discrimination, threats, and intentional harm.
2. No Doxxing - Sharing private personal information without consent.
3. No Advertising - Do not promote other servers, communities, products/services.
4. No Impersonation - Do not pretend to be staff, streamers, or any other players.
5. No Foreign Language - In public chat, only use English/Tagalog.
6. No False Report - Do not fabricate evidence to target others.
7. No Malicious Links or Files - Phishing links, malware, and harmful downloads.
8. No Public Drama - Avoid public arguments, for their only purpose is to drag everyone in. Seek assistance to resolve it. If it's outside of our server? It's on you to fix it. Don't drag us in. Learn to confront directly.
9. No Inappropriate Context - Any form of message, item renames, nicknames, image of NSFW, sexually explicit, excessively graphic, or otherwise inappropriate content is prohibited.
10. No Excessive Begging - Begging for items/ranks/access is prohibited. If a player/staff says no and still insists after being declined 3 times, it is punishable.
